params.negative: low quality, ugly, unfinished, out of focus, deformed, disfigure, blurry, smudged, restricted palette, flat colors

card.architecture: Chroma 8.9B (FLUX.1-schnell-derived DiT, T5-XXL only, fully open), whole-image img2img redraw
card.summary: Reinterpret an entire existing image through Chroma1-HD using a prompt — the source is used as the init latent and re-sampled at a partial denoise with NO mask, so the composition is kept but the whole frame is redrawn with Chroma's uncensored, FLUX-class coherence. The uncensored redraw: no safety alignment, real CFG, working negatives.
card.pick_when: You want an uncensored whole-image redraw with genuine negative-prompt control.

prompt.guidance: Natural-language prose; T5-only, so be descriptive. Real CFG with a working negative. Lower the redraw strength to stay close to the source composition; raise it to let Chroma reinterpret more.
prompt.example: A windswept cliff at dawn, a lone figure in a red cloak facing the sea, dramatic clouds, painterly, highly detailed
prompt.instructions:
Type the FULL description of the picture you want — this is a whole-frame re-render, not an edit instruction, and Chroma1-HD follows natural-language prose.
26 steps, euler/beta, real CFG 3.8, flow-shift 1.0. Chroma's T5 min-padding is disabled automatically.
'Redraw strength' (denoise) controls how far the result drifts from the source: ~0.3-0.5 keeps the source's structure and mostly restyles it, ~0.7+ substantially reinvents it.
The source is sampled at its OWN resolution — no downscale, so the output keeps the input's size (FLUX-class models hold up to ~2K; a very large source is slow and can exhaust VRAM).
Negative prompts DO apply here — Chroma samples at real CFG, so use them to steer what to avoid.

ui_help.note: Send an image + a description; the whole frame is redrawn through Chroma1-HD. 'Redraw strength' controls how far it drifts from the source.
ui_help.good_for: an uncensored whole-image redraw keeping the composition

edit_use_cases: whole-image img2img: redraw an entire image through Chroma1-HD from a prompt, keeping composition (uncensored)
